top_choice_rationale: P001 awards Katori and Ye for the optical lattice clock. The magic-wavelength condition cancels the trap light shift on the clock transition, Lamb-Dicke confinement removes first-order Doppler and recoil shifts, and many atoms are interrogated in parallel. The 10^-18 uncertainty has been reproduced by independent laboratories and used for tests of redshift and constants, so the achievement is mature and the two-name allocation is the cleanest on the shortlist. The citation is scoped to the lattice scheme, which separates it from the 2005 comb and 2012 ion-control prizes. No award is clearly worse than a mature, well-attributed achievement.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no documented collaboration with Katori or Ye, and my listed connections (Lindgren, L'Huillier, Lund, Keller, Schuch, Dahlstrom, Argenti, Indelicato) are not among the credited names
